intro-description-1: Flashcards are part of a system called spaced repetition, designed to improve retention of information and long term memory.
intro-description-2: Flashcards have questions and answers. They are reviewed regularly, right before the information is forgotten.
first-step-description: Decks are containers for cards and can be divided by subject. A deck is required to start creating cards.
second-step-description: Cards have a front and a back. On the back is the piece of information you want to memorize. The front should have a keyword or a question.
third-step-description: Test yourself on what you remember, each card have a unique review date that is adjusted after each review.
new-card-description: Cards you haven't studied to yet
familiar-card-description: Cards you are still learning. If neglected, they may be forgotten
mature-card-description: Cards with a high rentention rate that are unlikely to be forgotten
learning-journey: Learning is a never ending journey
learning-description: Whether you're a student, a professional expanding your knowledge, or a casual learner, make the process more intuitive.
learning-description-2: Plant the seeds of knowledge now :
no-deck: You have no decks to display
default-deck-message: Would you like to create a default deck ?
limit-message: Character limit reached, flashcards are best kept short
question-example: What is the capital of France ?
review-finished: No more cards to review for today
